location: Shin et al. (2025), Finding bullet (report line 1050): "Of 456 designers randomized"; citation "p. 8, Figure 5; pp. 8-9, Section 5.2".
claim: The finding reports 456 randomized designers and cites PDF pages 8-9.
problem: The cited pages do not contain the count of 456 randomized participants. The count is supported on PDF page 6, which should be added to the citation; the numerical value itself is correct.
evidence: C:/Dropbox/Research/ai-lab/literature/creativity/Shin et al (2025) - No Evidence for LLMs Being Useful in Problem Reframing.pdf; PDF p. 6, Figure 4, labels the randomized designers N = 456 and states that each participant was randomly assigned an approach. Section 4.2 on the same page reports 456 recruited individuals and 280 retained participants. PDF pp. 8-9 present the outcome results and do not report 456.
